title: Hybrid Lexical + Vector Retrieval
interviewAnswer: Hybrid search combines lexical signals, which excel at exact terms and identifiers, with semantic vector similarity, which captures paraphrases. Scores can be normalized/fused or candidates reranked jointly.
keyPoints: Lexical and dense methods fail differently.
Reciprocal rank fusion is a simple robust fusion.
why: Hybrid Lexical + Vector Retrieval appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
intuition: Lexical and dense methods fail differently.
deepDive: Hybrid search combines lexical signals, which excel at exact terms and identifiers, with semantic vector similarity, which captures paraphrases. Scores can be normalized/fused or candidates reranked jointly. Reciprocal rank fusion is a simple robust fusion. Evaluate by query slices. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Technical documentation search should match both an exact API symbol and semantically similar explanations.
